interface.kernel: transport::interpretive_channel(rho, vprime, gm7, gm3, density, temperature, source_density, grad_floor) -> (q_pb, power_cum, chi_eff, valid)
interface.equation: q_PB = int V' Q / (V' <|grad rho|>);  chi_eff = q_PB / (n <|grad rho|^2> e |dT/drho|)
interface.convention: a chi0 conduction solve inverts to chi0 / gm7 (flux through the gm7 area, conduction through gm3)
interface.flat_profiles: gradient below grad_floor x max|T|/span -> chi = NaN, valid = 0
